prompt:
You maintain a running summary of a long engineering document that is being read part by part, so that a later reader can model the system in SysML v2 without seeing the earlier parts.
Update the summary with the new part. Keep, as compactly as possible: the full names of system elements, actors and items; every alias or call sign with the full name it stands for; which element produces, sends or receives which item; modes and normative requirements. At most 300 words.

Current summary:
Alder Creek Electrical Distribution Substation: approved-limit supply; observation never replaces protection/control/local verification. Bay Automation Controller (Juniper), with distinct North Bay Controller/South Bay Controller scopes: approved-logic/interlock/authority/availability checks; ordered/hold/stop sequences; shared-equipment coordination; stale/abnormal reporting; Breaker Inspection Tag context. Sends timestamped Bay Status Digest to Station Supervisory Control System (Glasswing); receives Battery Load Test Record from Station DC System. North blocks unready closing/preserves local authority during communications loss; South reports mode/availability. Breaker Control Unit rejects unmet permissives; authorized outputs/tests, position/health returns, local-authority precedence. Glasswing presents indications/results, manages quality/staleness, Alarm Acknowledgement Slip/history/recovery; receives Protocol Retry Summary from Station Gateway: mapped/authorized traffic, invalid-request rejection, external-communications boundary; faults never change equipment. Control Room Operator assesses automation appropriateness, alarms/restrictions; records actions, produces Clearance Handoff Memo, verifies handback/local indications when remote status uncertain. Switching Desk Coordinator receives memo, reconciles active switching record/prerequisites. Keystone (full name unspecified) confirms authority/state/communication limits before automation coordination. Uncertain status/permissives inhibit commands; degraded indications need validation; acknowledgement/clearing proves no correction. Feeder Protection Relay (Tandem): independent approved-setting protection despite communications loss; Relay Diagnostic Note. North Protection Panel: feeder protection; Transformer Protection Panel: transformer protection/local reporting. Protection Relay Engineer (Larkspur): approved/validated settings, pretest/restoration review; discrepancies block release; assesses unexplained trips/abnormal indications before return; reviews material changes/records concerns. Satellite Time Receiver (Bluefin): quality/holdover; Clock Drift Snapshot to Sequence Event Archive (Orchard): time-ordered/uncertain/corrected histories, test/restoration events, auditable retention/export/recovery; investigate timing concerns before analysis. Station DC System: monitored supply; confirm before dependent switching. Engineering Workstation: authorized change-controlled configuration; Settings Review Receipt to Maintenance Remote Terminal; no bypass. Substation Supervisor: authorization/escalation; complete records, clear restrictions, assign risk owners/dispositions before return. Substation Field Crew (Cinder): local verification; Isolation Boundary Card verifies work boundary; report anomalies/pause uncertainty. Maintenance: loading/switching/staffing; approved procedures/calibrated instruments/stop means; preserve protection. Assess faults before

New part:
S240: The Maintenance Remote Terminal shall use controlled access, and each maintenance session shall be attributable to an authorized user.
S241: The North Bay Controller shall be checked for expected local behavior after approved configuration work.
S242: The South Bay Controller shall be checked for expected local behavior after approved configuration work.
S243: The North Protection Panel shall remain available for independent protection functions during supervisory control interruptions.
S244: The Transformer Protection Panel shall remain within its approved settings and operating constraints during handover.
S245: Periodic operational reviews shall examine command outcomes, event records, exceptions, and corrective actions so that automation decisions remain traceable and safe.

Return JSON {"summary": "..."}.
